products.title: The Physio Edge
products.body_html: What you will learn is how to understand posture as a living, dynamic system rather than just static alignment, and how to decode pain by identifying movement chains and compensation patterns. You will learn to read the body through the lens of the nervous system, breath, and emotions, while assessing patients using real-world observation instead of relying only on tools. The program also helps you use posture as an early indicator of fatigue and recovery needs, while building trust, improving communication, and developing strong clinical authority in your practice.
